definitions.explanation: Impressively expensive-looking, elaborate, or extravagant. Describes things that are richly decorated, high-quality, or abundant in a way that conveys wealth and sophistication.

examples.japanese: {豪華|ごうか}な⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧。
{豪華|ごうか}な⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{豪華|ごうか}な⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a gorgeous present for my birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}→忘年会：15800_bounenkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{豪華|ごうか}な⟦{客船|きゃくせん}→客船：16792_kyakusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ことになった。
examples.english: This year's end-of-year party will be held on a luxurious cruise ship.

notes:
A positive word conveying impressiveness and richness. Unlike ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧ which can imply wastefulness, ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧ is purely appreciative and is often used in advertising and media to attract customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}{客船|きゃくせん}→豪華客船：23828_goukakyakusen⟧: luxury cruise ship
- {豪華|ごうか}な⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: lavish meal
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧⟦{絢爛|けんらん}→絢爛：09200_kenran⟧: gorgeous and splendid
- {豪華|ごうか}な⟦{顔|かお}ぶれ→顔ぶれ：14671_kaobure⟧: star-studded lineup
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧⟦{賞品|しょうひん}→賞品：21558_shouhin⟧: lavish prizes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧な: extravagant — can imply excessive or wasteful spending
- ⟦{華|はな}やか→華やか：06070_hanayaka⟧な: glamorous — emphasizes brightness and showiness
- ⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な: magnificent — emphasizes dignified impressiveness
